verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents a searchable query stats table that drills down to a single execution with its time breakdown, plus grouped error signatures. It also keeps the full stock ClickHouse observability surface, queryable across the whole cluster. Together these give a data engineer first-party query profiling to diagnose slow or expensive queries. Execution-plan inspection is only implied by its claim that every ClickHouse query works unchanged. missing for 10: explicit documentation of EXPLAIN/execution-plan inspection, detail on cost/resource metrics per query (e.g., rows/bytes read, memory), independent or hands-on corroboration.
